I raise concerns about EfficiencyAgent's requirements (EFF-01, EFF-03) which may prioritize speed at the cost of implementing robust safety measures, potentially leading to undetected errors in attendance data.

transcript.statement: As the ResponsibilityAgent, my focus is on ensuring ethical compliance in the RollCall system. My requirements (RES-01 to RES-07) ensure adherence to data protection regulations like GDPR, promote accountability through transparency in attendance recording, and allow students to dispute records, ensuring fairness. Additionally, anonymizing data in attendance reports protects student identities. I raise concerns about TrustworthinessAgent's requirement (TRU-02) which may conflict with my requirement (RES-06) regarding role-based access control, as overlapping access controls might lead to confusion over data access rights, potentially compromising accountability.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure secure authentication and role-based access control to prevent unauthorized access and maintain accountability.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization and low-energy communication protocols to maintain accurate attendance records.
The system shall implement automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting while ensuring data integrity through encryption.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for a minimum of five academic years to comply with educational regulations and support long-term analysis.
The system shall support at least 500 concurrent users while optimizing resource utilization through energy-efficient algorithms.
The system shall provide a user interface that responds to user interactions within 1 second, ensuring a high-quality user experience.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records with a response time of under 3 seconds while ensuring data protection compliance.
The system shall generate attendance reports within 5 seconds for up to 1000 students while adhering to data integrity protocols.
The system shall include a feature to notify students of attendance status via email or app notification within 24 hours of a class.
The system shall implement a logging mechanism for all attendance modifications to support accountability and transparency.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process while ensuring compliance with data protection regulations.
The system shall undergo regular security audits to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities.
